headline:
On earth
as it is in heaven.
headline_sub: Every project is a community hearing the Word in its own voice. Track progress, health and field-team needs.
btn_reload_title: Reload data from the spreadsheet (clears local cache)
confirm_reload: Reload data from the spreadsheet? This discards unexported local changes and reloads the 127 projects from the database.
sb_no_saved_views: Save filter combos you use every week.
sb_view_copy_link: Copy a link to this view
sb_view_limit: You already have {{count}} saved views. Delete one before saving another.
sb_view_partial: Opened without {{filters}}: no project carries that value anymore.
role_coordinator_sub: Finances and strategic communication with field teams
role_obtlab_sub: Tracks translation progress and training/workshop needs
role_resource_sub: Receives prayer requests, prays and shares with the intercessor network
preset_urgent_sub: Critical health · no news · urgent needs
empty_sub: Adjust filters or register the first project.
empty_search_sub: Nothing found for “{{term}}”. Adjust the search or clear the filters.
record_draft_persist_failed: The draft exceeded local storage and may not survive a reload — save the record or remove photos.
record_required_here: A required field lives in this tab
record_save_blocked: Fill the required fields before saving.
f_required: Required before the project can be saved.
f_iso_hint: An ISO 639-3 code has three letters. The value is stored exactly as typed.
f_coords_hint: Longitude and latitude in decimal degrees. Left blank, the project is plotted at its region's centre.
d_coords_missing: No coordinates — plotted at the region's centre
f_sensitive_on_map: On the Atlas the project is plotted at its region's centre, never at the real place, and the map announces how many projects are being withheld.
f_sensitive_on_cards: Cards and map tooltips show the region name in place of the country and the location.
f_sensitive_on_pending: Exports, the prayer wall, the ETEN report and notifications do not apply the rule yet — that lands in wave 2, on the server.
f_materials_hint: Import the already-translated audio and text. Indicate the type and scope of each material.
mat_invalid_type: The file does not match the material type — check the selected type
materials_empty: No translated material recorded yet — the already-translated audio and text land here, each with its type and scope.
notes_empty: No notes yet — this is the free space for what the numbers do not capture, in any language.
notes_internal_hint: Notes are internal by default — they stay with coordination. Nothing exports or shares notes today; when outputs arrive, in wave 2, the rule holds server-side.
f_media_intro: Share field-work moments — team photos, the translated material, dedication events, trainings.
media_auth_intro: Usage authorization: check each photo/video the team authorizes for public sharing. Without the check, the item stays restricted.
media_auth_pending: No decision recorded — treated as restricted use
media_auth_disabled_hint: Add a photo or caption to decide sharing
media_auth_sensitive: Sensitive country: even an authorized item stays out of any public-facing output — the most restrictive rule wins. What the flag protects today is described in the Identity tab.
media_invalid_type: Unsupported format — use PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF
progress_books_hint: Mark the books in translation and update how many chapters are at each stage.
progress_stories_hint: Add each story and track its progress.
progress_no_scope_hint: Set the scope in the Objective tab to record progress by book, story or unit.
progress_decrease_warn: Below the last saved record: {{fields}}. The decrease will be recorded in the progress history.
int_lead: Register intercessors and groups worldwide. Send the prayer wall requests to each one directly, by WhatsApp or email.
int_empty: No intercessors registered yet. Add name, country and contact above.
int_footnote: Sent requests come from the Prayer Wall — only those teams authorized to share.
int_needs_country: Pick the country from the list — it is what groups the network.
int_needs_contact: Give a WhatsApp number or an email — without a channel the record serves no purpose.
int_send_pending: Sending the requests arrives in wave 2. For now the network is only registered here.
int_privacy_note: These are details of people who do not use the platform. Keep only those who consented to receive the requests, and remove anyone who asks — removing here erases the contact, it does not hide it.
int_remove_confirm: Remove {{name}} from the network? The contact is erased.
equipe_lead: Add and update the names of the three roles in each region. Changes appear in the sidebar, meetings and projects.
equipe_hint: Edit the names and click save.
equipe_bodies_title: The tables that hold it up
equipe_body_leadership_purpose: Holds the ecosystem’s direction and answers for Shemá as a whole.
equipe_body_resource_purpose: Provides the financial resources that let the projects happen.
equipe_body_projects_purpose: Coordinates the regional teams and keeps the operation flowing.
equipe_no_hierarchy: No table commands another. Each regional role is a partnership with one of them — there is no chain of command here.
equipe_fill_hint: Type a name in the role’s field to fill it.
equipe_appears_sidebar: Projects · “Team by region”, in the sidebar
equipe_appears_ritmo: Rhythm · who takes part in each meeting
equipe_appears_ficha: Record · the Team tab of every project in the region
equipe_history_note: Every change is recorded with who made it and when. In wave 2 that becomes an access fact, not a screen detail.
forms_eyebrow: Field forms · Where to find them
forms_lead: Two forms bring news from the teams, each in its own time. Pick the project to see what each one asks, who fills it in, and how the answer comes back.
forms_footnote: The Monthly Pulse is a form the leader fills in alone on a phone, with no connectivity, and returns. The Health Assessment opens inside the app, run by the Facilitator during the meeting with the team.
forms_received_empty: No forms archived yet. Once importing arrives, every filled form is kept here exactly as it came, for you to download anytime.
forms_pulse_desc: It starts with the person, not the numbers: the team speaks first, shows a photo, and only then records the chapters. Works offline on the phone and saves by itself.
forms_pulse_mechanism: Leaves the app as a form, comes back filled in over WhatsApp or email.
forms_health_desc: Not the leader alone: the Facilitator runs a live conversation with the team, walking through four dimensions of life in the field — emotional, relational, spiritual and physical.
forms_health_mechanism: Opens inside the app during the meeting. It produces no file at all: nothing is downloaded, sent or returned.
forms_mechanism_file: A file that leaves and returns
forms_step_generate_detail: here in the Forms tab, choosing the project.
forms_step_send_detail: to the field leader, over WhatsApp or email.
forms_step_answer_detail: on the phone, with no connectivity, and returns the filled form.
forms_step_import_detail: and Progress, Team Health and Needs update themselves.
forms_step_archive_detail: the filled form is kept, and coordination is notified straight away.
forms_q_voice: How was this month? — the team’s voice, as audio or text.
forms_q_photo: Show the work. — a photo of the team, the elders or the printed material.
forms_q_chapters: Chapters closed. — translated, community-checked and approved.
forms_q_blockers: Is anything in the way? — what is missing this month: resources, equipment, training.
forms_q_prayer: What do we carry in prayer? — with explicit authorization for the intercessor network.
forms_readiness: {{reported}} of {{total}} projects reported in the {{form}} cycle closing on {{date}}.
forms_pending_title: Who has not reported the {{form}} yet
forms_pending_none: Every project has already reported in the current {{form}} cycle.
forms_loop_closed: What this period asked for has already arrived from {{project}}.
forms_loop_open: For {{project}}, this period’s loop still starts at “You generate”.
forms_format_pending: The Pulse file format is still being settled with the client, so no screen promises one.
forms_actions_pending: Generating the Pulse and importing the answer arrive in wave 2. For now this screen shows the loop, what each form asks, and who has not reported yet.
forms_reporting_note: This count is the {{form}} only: “reported” reads the project’s update date, the same signal Rhythm uses for {{form}} readiness. No {{form}} has been generated or imported yet.
forms_no_projects: No projects registered yet. Register a project to follow its Pulse here.
oracao_lead: Every prayer request — from the Monthly Pulse and the Health Assessments — gathered here to share with intercessor groups around the world.
oracao_empty: No prayer requests yet. When teams submit the forms, requests appear here.
oracao_footnote: TXT to share with groups · CSV and JSON for the intercession database. Requests come from both forms (Monthly Pulse and Health Assessment).
eten_lead: ETEN funds most of Shema's resources. Each year we report how far each project advanced. Each completed defined scope is worth 1 credit — and the credit total corresponds to the next cycle's resources. Only projects on the ETEN list are counted.
eten_empty: No projects marked on the ETEN list. Mark "Language on ETEN list" in each project form.
eten_footnote: Credit is per completed defined scope, counted in approved chapters: a 25-chapter project and a 260-chapter New Testament are worth 1 credit each, on closing their own scope. Update each project's progress for it to reach the report.
eten_year_no_data: No listed project has progress recorded up to {{year}}. A year with no data is not a year of zero credits — they mean different things to a funder.
eten_undated_note: The project is marked completed, but the status field does not record when — the credit could not be attributed to a year. Enter the credit by hand for the right year.
eten_carryover_open: What happens to partial progress on a scope not yet closed has not been defined: today it earns no credit.
eten_rule_pending: Counting rule given by the client and still pending formal confirmation with Youngshin (GATE-01).
eten_export_pending: The CSV export and the PDF report arrive in wave 2.
ritmo_lead: Shema means "listen". Each meeting is a step of that listening — information flows from the field to leadership, and care flows back. Forms feed the meetings; meetings feed the decisions.
ritmo_m1_desc: The Language Operations reviews the region’s team pulses each month and decides what to escalate to the quarterly meeting.
ritmo_m2_desc: The region’s Language Operations runs the quarterly Health Assessment with each translation team in the region.
ritmo_m3_desc: The Global Strategist meets quarterly with each region’s Language Operations and Administrator to align progress, resources and the quarter’s plan.
ritmo_m6_desc: The Intercessor compiles the month’s prayer requests and shares them with the intercessor network.
ritmo_m7_desc: The Global Strategist and the Administrator bring the regions’ accumulated financial needs to the Resource Circle each quarter.
ritmo_m4_desc: The Global Strategist and Shema leadership review the health of the whole ecosystem and strategic direction.
ritmo_m5_desc: Everyone together: year in review, answered prayers, translation milestones delivered.
ritmo_readiness: Teams that already reported this period
ritmo_flow_note: Information flows from the field to leadership → · ← care and resources flow back
ritmo_notes_kept: Anything you type is kept, even if you close without saving.
ritmo_no_projects: No projects yet — the meetings appear as soon as the first region has any.
stale_warn_text: No news from the field for
placeholder_location2: Other country where the language is spoken (optional)
f_sensitive_hint: Check if public exposure could put the team at risk.
placeholder_financial_notes: Notes about the project's financial situation...
f_base_hint: YWAM and JOCUM are the same name in two languages. Whatever is written here holds for both fields on the record.
f_people_hint: Separate with commas, or add one at a time.
f_roles_hint: These three names come from the region's org chart, not from this record. They change in one place and hold for every project in the region.
f_contact_sensitive: Project flagged as a sensitive country. These contacts are personal data — the Identity tab describes what the flag protects today.
f_phases_hint: Split the project into periods. Each phase has its own goal and deadline.
health_q_relational: How are things between you as a team?
health_q_spiritual: How is the walk with God?
health_lead: Four questions for listening to the team. None of them needs an answer today — leaving one blank says it has not been talked about yet.
health_care_critical: This team asked for help. Critical is not a low score — it is a call to care.
health_care_attention: This team signalled strain. Worth a conversation before the next assessment.
health_never_assessed: This team has not been through a health conversation yet. Until then the project is not counted as well — it is counted as not yet heard.
d_health_history_empty: This is the first conversation on record.
prayer_vis_coordination_hint: Stays with coordination, who follow up and support. It does not reach the prayer wall.
prayer_vis_network_hint: The team authorised sharing this with the intercessor network. It appears on the prayer wall.
prayer_vis_default_note: Without explicit authorization the request stays with coordination only.
need_status_dropped_hint: Leaves the open list and stays on the record, with the date it stopped being needed.
needs_lead: What this team is missing right now. It is a request for help, not a report on the team — each line is something a region can pick up and close.
needs_empty: No request on record. When the team says what is missing, put it here so the region can pick it up.
need_urgency_hint: Urgency is about the request, not about the team's health.
progress_tip: Number changes are automatically saved to history.
toast_field_generated: Field form generated — send to the team.
toast_obj_required: Select at least one project type.
confirm_delete: Delete this project? This cannot be undone.
confirm_import: Import will replace current projects. Continue?
tweaks_metaphor_sub: How do you want to see the projects today?
field_sub: Fill in and download the file to send back to coordination.
field_pastoral_question: Does the team need pastoral support right now?
field_saved: Update generated. Send the file to your coordinator.
field_instr_1: Update the numbers below to reflect real progress since the last check.
field_instr_3: Add notes, prayer requests or recent context.
field_instr_4: Click "Download update" and email the .json file to coordination.
notif_sub: Tell me whenever a team sends a form. I choose how and when.
notif_channels_hint: Delivery itself — email, push, WhatsApp, the 8 AM digest — arrives in wave 2; your choice is already recorded.
notif_when_now_sub: Each form triggers an immediate notification.
notif_when_urgent_sub: Critical health, urgent need, no news for 60+ days.
notif_when_daily_sub: One digest at 8 AM with everything that arrived that day.
notif_preview_body: +4 chapters translated, team tired but steady, asking for checking training.
notif_foot: Your preferences are saved in this browser.
notif_empty: Nothing here for now — when the field sends a form or a case calls for care, it shows up in this list.
notif_empty_off: Notifications are off — turn the switch above back on to receive them again.
atlas_sensitive_notice_one: {{count}} project in a sensitive country — shown at region level, not the exact location
atlas_sensitive_notice_other: {{count}} projects in sensitive countries — shown at region level, not the exact locations
export_sub: The file leaves ready to be passed on — so it leaves reduced.
export_contains: Shemá Ecosystem projects — identity, scope, progress, health, open needs and shared prayer requests. No personal contacts, internal notes or media.
export_confidential: Confidential — for the coordination's internal use. Do not pass it on without agreeing with the responsible team.
export_withheld_count_one: {{count}} project in a sensitive country leaves with its location and base withheld — the region shown in place of the location.
export_withheld_count_other: {{count}} projects in sensitive countries leave with their locations and bases withheld — the region shown in place of the location.
import_desc: The file is checked first: either it goes in whole, or nothing changes. Any error rejects the entire import.
import_invalid_json: The file could not be read as JSON.
import_is_export: This file is the exported report — reduced on purpose, it cannot restore the projects.
import_not_list: The content is not a list of projects.
import_bad_record: Item {{index}} is not a valid project record.
import_duplicate_id: The id {{id}} appears more than once.
receive_desc: The leader's answer comes back from the field and is applied to the project — progress, health and needs enter the record, and the received file is kept exactly as it arrived.
receive_pending: Importing the answer arrives in wave 2. For now, the Forms area shows the Pulse loop and who has not reported yet.
intake_sub: New project intake, straight from the field.
intake_desc: The link opens the intake form for a new project, for a leader who does not use the console.
intake_scope: Scope: the intake only. The link opens no console and shows no data from any existing project.
intake_expiry: Validity: the link expires and serves a single intake — whoever needs to register again receives a new link.
intake_pending: Generating the link arrives in wave 2.
